sections.kicker: Prepared for The Nursery Store by Atla · November 2026
sections.lead: We looked at your site the way a new customer would. Here is what stood out, in order of weight.
sections.thesis: The Nursery Store has a warm voice and thirty eight years of history, and both are in small type under the loudest banner.
sections.keep: The line about being there since 1987. It sounds like a person, and no competitor can copy it.

pins.quote: You've got this. We've got you - since 1987.
pins.what: The tagline is the only line with a voice.
pins.why: It is the reassurance a nervous parent needs, and it is set small beneath a banner that sounds nothing like it.
pins.how: Give the line the headline position and let it set the tone.
pins.label: Your tagline
pins.cost: The warmest thing on the page is read after the loudest.

pins.what: Puggle is the store's own pushchair brand, listed beside ordinary categories.
pins.why: A shop that makes its own product has something no other retailer can sell, and the menu treats it as one more shelf.
pins.how: Introduce Puggle as the brand's own point of view.
pins.label: Your menu
pins.cost: A retailer that sells the same brands as everyone else competes on the shelf.

pins.area: The serif The Nursery Store wordmark at top left of the header
pins.what: The name is a description of the shop.
pins.why: A nursery store is what a dozen retailers are called, and the serif wordmark carries a softness that the name does not.
pins.how: Let the wordmark and the 1987 story do the naming.
pins.label: Your name
pins.cost: Parents remember a store by its name, and this one reads as a category.

sections.body: It is 20 minutes with me. We go through this page together, on The Nursery Store's own screens, and you leave knowing what to change first.
sections.note: A few short questions first, then you pick a time. You can also just reply to the email.

reference: John Lewis, from another category. Its history and its warmth are the brand, and it says so in a few words.
